input_policy: Existing exact mask fragments joined in source order with one space. No original-note context, generated subject, template, paraphrase, dictionary, or training. Empty string is used only as the author's geometric root.
selection: Twenty saved masks selected before scores by an independent clean-context reader. Full notes retained only for human interpretation. This is not a representative accuracy estimate or a prescribed hierarchy.
hypothesis: The released text geometry distinguishes some supported broad-to-narrow directions and separates those relationships from obvious cross-topic alternatives on our exact masks.
interpretation_notes: The three bread checks reuse one nested trio, not three independent successes.
Ice versus iced coffee is related through an ingredient; inspect, without requiring a subtype-only interpretation.
Coffee-shop music is plausibly reachable through a coffee-shop or music subject. Do not demand one unique parent or reject all coffee-related paths.
The isolated Gentoo mask leaves its word sense implicit. Inspect Linux/Gentoo but do not count a mandatory direction.
Knowledge-sharing and a Bitcoin workshop may support topical refinement without logical implication of an injunction.
Added qualifications in V627/V629 and V618/V619 may retain essentially the same browsing subject. No mandatory extra level.
All 400 ordered pairs, including self-pairs with undefined directional angle, will be preserved. No score cutoff will be fitted.
A favorable pilot would justify further investigation, not qualify full hierarchy construction. A failure would apply to this checkpoint/input/scorer setup, not every hierarchy embedding model.
